name: ffmpeg_tool
description: Free local/worker media inspection and fixed reframing. Fixed operations only; no commands, filtergraphs, URLs or network access. Always execute on the machine containing job_id. Missing binaries fail softly; Lambda hosts without ffmpeg cannot run binary ops.

op.description: Allowed values: crop_plan_preview, reframe_crop, reframe_pad_blur, detect_scenes, probe, extract_frames, contact_sheet, sha256, check_faststart, volume_stats. One of: crop_plan_preview, reframe_crop, reframe_pad_blur, detect_scenes, probe, extract_frames, contact_sheet, sha256, check_faststart, volume_stats.

job_id.description: Existing job directory under RENDERHAUS_MEDIA_DIR. ASCII id, 1 to 80 characters.

input_path.description: Readable regular file inside this job. Relative path or confined absolute path. No URLs, traversal or option prefixes.

aspect.description: crop_plan_preview: Target aspect enum. Nominal sizes come from the shared aspect table. reframe_crop: Target aspect enum. Nominal sizes come from the shared aspect table. One of: 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9, 2.39:1.

subject_box.description: crop_plan_preview: Optional box in displayed source pixels. x/y nonnegative, dimensions positive, within source. crop_box requires even integers; subject_box is only a crop-centre hint, never detection. reframe_crop: Optional box in displayed source pixels. x/y nonnegative, dimensions positive, within source. crop_box requires even integers; subject_box is only a crop-centre hint, never detection.

crop_box.description: crop_plan_preview: Optional box in displayed source pixels. x/y nonnegative, dimensions positive, within source. crop_box requires even integers; subject_box is only a crop-centre hint, never detection. reframe_crop: Optional box in displayed source pixels. x/y nonnegative, dimensions positive, within source. crop_box requires even integers; subject_box is only a crop-centre hint, never detection.

safe_zone.description: crop_plan_preview: Safe-zone fraction overrides top,bottom,side; leave at least 5% inner width/height. Null uses configured aspect placeholders. reframe_crop: Safe-zone fraction overrides top,bottom,side; leave at least 5% inner width/height. Null uses configured aspect placeholders. reframe_pad_blur: Safe-zone fraction overrides top,bottom,side; leave at least 5% inner width/height. Null uses configured aspect placeholders.

anchor.description: crop_plan_preview: Static centre or edge anchor. A supplied subject box takes precedence. reframe_crop: Static centre or edge anchor. A supplied subject box takes precedence. One of: center, top, bottom, left, right.

allow_upscale.description: crop_plan_preview: Allow crop/foreground resampling to table size; disclosed as no added detail. reframe_crop: Allow crop/foreground resampling to table size; disclosed as no added detail. reframe_pad_blur: Allow crop/foreground resampling to table size; disclosed as no added detail.

size.description: reframe_pad_blur: Target aspect enum. Nominal sizes come from the shared aspect table. One of: 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9, 2.39:1.

times.description: extract_frames: 1 to 20 frame times, each 0 to 600 seconds. Default [0].

width.description: extract_frames: Allowed range: 16 to 1920. Default 640. contact_sheet: Allowed range: 16 to 640. Default 320.

params.description: Per-op parameters only. probe, sha256, check_faststart, volume_stats take no params. extract_frames uses times,width. contact_sheet uses every_s,cols,rows,width,height. Outputs never overwrite existing files.
